steps.en: Install it with the extras for the formats you need
steps.zh: 按需要的格式装上可选依赖
steps.code: pip install 'markitdown[all]' · pip install 'markitdown[pdf, docx, pptx]'

steps.en: Point it at a file from the CLI, or call convert() from Python
steps.zh: 命令行指给它一个文件，或在 Python 里调用 convert()

steps.en: Detects the real file type and picks the matching converter
steps.zh: 识别文件真实类型，挑出对应的转换器

steps.en: The format library extracts text, headings, lists, tables and links
steps.zh: 用该格式的库抽出文字、标题、列表、表格和链接

steps.en: Writes everything out as one Markdown document

value.en: One call turns a mixed pile of Office, HTML and PDF files into Markdown an LLM can read
value.zh: 一次调用，把一堆混杂的 Office、HTML、PDF 文件变成大模型读得懂的 Markdown

sources: https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown/blob/main/packages/markitdown/pyproject.toml (magika, pdfminer.six, pdfplumber, mammoth, python-pptx, pandas converters)
